info.name: CIMS - College Internship Management System API
info.description: End-to-end API checks for CIMS. Prerequisites: backend running with database/schema.sql + database/seed.sql loaded and database/seed-files/sample-resume.pdf copied to <FILE_STORAGE_PATH>/seed/. Select the 'CIMS - local' environment (or set baseUrl) and run the folders in order: the Auth folder stores the tokens used by the other folders. The run creates data, so reload seed.sql on a fresh database before running it again from the start.

exec: // Dates relative to today (yyyy-MM-dd) used by internship and interview requests.
const day = (n) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); const p = (x) => String(x).padStart(2, '0'); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`; };
